title.narrative: Sveriges och Kosovos jämställdhetsmyndigheter: GEAR up 2024-2027
Sweden and Kosovo Agency for Equality: GEAR up 2024-2027

description.narrative: GEAR-up is an authority collaboration between Kosovo's and Sweden's equality authorities. The goal is to strengthen Kosovo's institution in the long term in its coordinating role for state and municipality - for increased gender equality in important social functions.

GEAR-up är ett myndighetssamarbete mellan Kosovos och Sveriges jämställdhetsmyndigheter. Målet är att stärka Kosovos institution långsiktigt i dess samordnande roll för stat och kommun - för ökad jämställdhet i viktiga samhällsfunktioner.

The project GEAR-Up for Gender Equality, with activities until December 2027 is a collaboration between the Gender Equality Agencies from Kosovo and Sweden. The agreement partner for Sida is the Swedish agency.
The overall objective is that the Kosovo gender equality institutional mechanisms have a robust organisation and enhanced capabilities at all levels which support effective and efficient delivery of mandates on gender equality. The intervention has two sub-goals, 1) to strengthen capabilities and 2) to increase effectiveness of organisational instruments. Furthermore, there are three key components of the project:
- Effective structures and systems for the implementation of gender equality commitments through mainly gender mainstreaming and gender responsive budgeting on both local and national level.
- Strengthened communication and dissemination on gender equality and impactfull collaboration and coordination established with stakeholders and others.
- Strengthened application of gender data and statistics, and analysis capabilities as well as effective and efficient monitoring and reporting system.
Long-term impact of the project and partnership is to contribute to gender equality being placed at the centre of the transformation processes in Kosovo, within all structures, institutions, policies, procedures, practices, and processes of government agencies in the society, private sector and the donor community.
